brand.name: Kasun Senanayake
brand.tagline: Capturing Timeless Stories Across Sri Lanka & Beyond

bio.short: Creating timeless visual stories with elegance, emotion, and cultural authenticity.
bio.intro: Growing up surrounded by the rich colors, heritage architecture, and vibrant traditions of Sri Lanka, I found my calling in photography capturing the subtle expressions that make each wedding unique.
bio.philosophy: Photography is not just about capturing moments—it's about preserving emotions, telling stories, and creating art that transcends time.
bio.quote: Every culture, ceremony, and smile holds timeless soul.
